title: Tim Dooley Science, Physics and Formal Explorations
epistemic_rule: This record separates recovered Potatoverse equations and speculative models from established mathematics and physics. A structural analogy is not evidence that Potatoverse theology is a physical theory or that Tim Dooley has discovered a new force, dimension, particle or cosmology.

present_timic_position.project_canon: In present Potatoverse theology Tim Dooley is not positioned underground. Tim is described as King of Kings, Father in Heaven, seated at the throne/seat of the Most High in the highest Heaven and as the highest spiritual authority within the Potatoverse. Potato burial and subterranean growth belong to origin, biological and transformation symbolism, not to Tim's present enthroned location.
present_timic_position.footstool_language: The world-below-the-throne is repeatedly described through footstool language. Dog language is a polemical project metaphor and should not be indexed as a statement about the literal human worth or legal status of people.

m_theory.fact: Witten's 1995 strong-coupling analysis showed that eleven-dimensional supergravity arises as the low-energy limit of strongly coupled Type IIA string theory, a cornerstone of what became M-theory.
m_theory.timic_use: The old 11D Potato motif can be retained as an analogy to an 11-dimensional unifying framework, but 11 dimensions do not scientifically validate Potatoverse cosmology.

calabi_yau.fact: Calabi-Yau manifolds are Ricci-flat Kähler spaces with vanishing first Chern class under standard definitions. In ten-dimensional superstring compactification, a Calabi-Yau threefold supplies six real compact dimensions, leaving an effective four-dimensional spacetime.
calabi_yau.timic_use: Useful for the distinction between visible macroscopic dimensions and compact internal geometry; not evidence that a Potato, pineal gland, Door or spiritual realm is literally Calabi-Yau shaped.

m_theory_g2_correction.fact: For compactifying eleven-dimensional M-theory directly to four dimensions while preserving minimal supersymmetry, the mathematically natural special-holonomy space is seven-dimensional with G2 holonomy. Calabi-Yau threefolds are central to ten-dimensional string compactification and also enter M-theory duality chains, but they are not the generic seven-dimensional 11D-to-4D replacement by themselves.
m_theory_g2_correction.timic_use: Future 11D Potato models should distinguish Calabi-Yau six-manifolds from G2 seven-manifolds instead of treating 'Calabi-Yau' as a generic synonym for any hidden dimensions.

kaluza_klein_radion.fact: Compact extra dimensions produce Kaluza-Klein towers and scalar moduli associated with the size/shape of the internal space. A radion is a field describing an extra dimension's size in common extra-dimensional models.
kaluza_klein_radion.schematic_metric: ds_5^2 = g_{μν}(x) dx^μ dx^ν + R^2(x) (dy + A_μ dx^μ)^2
kaluza_klein_radion.timic_use: This is the strongest real-physics ancestor for the recovered R(x), φ(x) Door model, while remaining an analogy unless a complete action, field content, constraints and testable predictions are supplied.

phase_transition.fact: Physics uses order parameters and critical points to distinguish phases. Spontaneous symmetry breaking provides a rigorous example in which the equations retain a symmetry while the realized state selects a less symmetric vacuum.
phase_transition.timic_use: The Door threshold Ξ_c is best treated as a Landau-style conceptual phase boundary unless the project defines a measurable Ξ and derives dynamics.

black_hole_boundary.fact: An event horizon is a causal boundary: once inside a classical black-hole horizon, signals cannot return to an outside observer. It is not a material surface or experimentally established portal into another spiritual dimension.
black_hole_boundary.equation: r_s = 2GM/c^2 for a non-rotating uncharged Schwarzschild black hole
black_hole_boundary.timic_use: Useful Door analogy: irreversible boundary crossing and observer-dependent access to information.

conifold_transition.fact: String theory on Calabi-Yau spaces has genuine singular loci in moduli space. Strominger showed that certain conifold singularities can be smoothed in the effective theory by including light nonperturbative states.
conifold_transition.timic_use: A stronger technical analogue for 'compression/singularity → new smooth regime' than generic black-hole imagery, though still not a proof of Timic transformation physics.

holography.fact: Maldacena's AdS/CFT proposal relates certain gravitational/string theories in a higher-dimensional Anti-de Sitter bulk to conformal field theories on a lower-dimensional boundary.
holography.timic_use: The Holographic Potato motif can be reframed as a disciplined boundary/bulk analogy: lower-dimensional data may encode a higher-dimensional description in specific dual theories. This is not the statement that everyday reality is proven to be a hologram.

many_worlds.fact: Everett's relative-state formulation keeps universal quantum evolution continuous and treats observer-system correlations without a fundamental collapse postulate. Later 'many-worlds' language is an interpretation of this formalism.
many_worlds.timic_use: Use for branching histories only when discussing quantum interpretation; do not use it to claim that imagined or narrative timelines physically coexist or communicate.

earth_precession.fact: Earth's axial precession cycle is about 25,771.5 years, not exactly 26,000 years.
earth_precession.timic_use: The old '26,000-year precession Eye' can retain its approximate astronomical motif while the archive records the actual measured/derived cycle separately.

milky_way_shape.fact: The Milky Way is observed/modelled as a barred spiral galaxy with a flattened stellar/gaseous disk, central bar/bulge and extended halo; it is not scientifically classified as a torus.
milky_way_shape.timic_use: Toroidal Milky Way should remain a symbolic or exploratory geometry motif unless tied to a more specific physical structure such as magnetic-field topology rather than overall galactic morphology.

starchforce.original_project_intuition: Gravity makes things fall; electromagnetism, strong and weak interactions have their established roles; Starchforce was invented as the force that 'makes the potato potato'.
starchforce.later_formalization: A speculative coupling to information-bearing organization or persistent stored structure was explored, with Spudlight revealing potential and Starchforce organizing/storing potential.
starchforce.biological_grounding: Actual potato tubers store chemical energy predominantly as starch. This gives a legitimate metaphor of latent stored capacity but is not evidence for a new fundamental force.
starchforce.falsifiability_requirement: A real fifth-force proposal would need a defined field, coupling, Lagrangian or equations of motion and reproducible deviations from established interactions. A particularly strong test would require systems matched in known physical properties but differing only in the hypothesized organization variable.
